prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Ao Guang, the East Sea Dragon King in the documented small-snake transformation. Native PNG at least 1024 by 1024 pixels.
ANATOMY: One small snake, one head, two eyes, one continuous coiling body and one tail, absolutely no legs, wings, horns or human crown. [ao-guang-c08]
MOMENT: Rear and tighten a wet coil toward the viewer, open mouth in an intense close confrontation.
POWER: Tiny raindrops strike sand and pebble surfaces, reflecting his documented storm domain; no giant spray, fire, staff or invented glow. [ao-guang-c06]
SCALE & CAMERA: GROUND-LEVEL EXTREME MACRO photograph-like framing: a tiny snake no thicker than a twig rears between individual rounded beach pebbles; its head is smaller than one pebble. Pebbles fill the foreground. No rock cliffs or huge breaking waves; only blurred distant sea beyond the beach; distinguishing anatomy remains clear at 200 pixels.
LIGHT & WEATHER: One warm break in the storm provides rim light; real rain and sea spray.
SURFACE: tactile natural fur, hair, feather, skin, cloth, scale or metal as appropriate to the documented form, never plastic.
SETTING: Wet sand and small rounded pebbles on the East Sea beach, ocean far away and blurred. [ao-guang-c01]
MOOD: reverent awe-inspiring presence, overwhelming and imposing; never cute, calm or decorative. Dark walnut, antique gold and parchment palette with one strong accent.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, glyph, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
